listen_addresses.description: IP addresses and ports where dnscrypt-proxy will listen for DNS queries.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections supported.

query_window.description: Time window (in seconds) used to count queries per client for rate limiting.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 = quiet, 1 = info (default), 2 = debug.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to log only to stderr.

use_syslog.description: If true, send logs to syslog instead of a file.

log_days.description: Number of days to keep log files before rotation.

listen_addresses.description: IP:port(s) to bind DoH server to.

path.description: URL path for the DoH endpoint (e.g., /dns-query).

doh_servers.description: List of DoH upstream providers to use for encrypted DNS resolution.

name.description: Unique identifier for this DoH server (e.g., cloudflare-doh).

provider_name.description: Provider name (used in TLS SNI and certificate validation).

bootstrap_dns.description: Fallback plain DNS servers used to bootstrap the DoH connection.

public_key.description: Base64-encoded public key for DoH server validation.

dnscrypt_servers.description: List of DNSCrypt servers to use.

name.description: Unique identifier for this DNSCrypt server.

server_ip.description: Optional override IP address for this server.

fallback_resolvers.description: Plain DNS resolvers used as fallback (UDP/TCP).

address.description: IP:port or just IP (port defaults to 53).

routes.description: Custom routing rules to direct queries to specific upstream servers.

server_names.description: List of upstream server names to route matching queries to.

block_ipv6_queries.description: If true, block all IPv6 (AAAA) queries (to force IPv4-only).

block_certain_queries.description: If true, block queries for certain types (e.g., AXFR, ANY) for security.

server_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a response from upstream servers before retrying.

server_retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a server after a failed request.

cache_size.description: Maximum number of entries to keep in the response cache.

cache_min_ttl.description: Minimum time (seconds) to cache a successful response.

cache_max_ttl.description: Maximum time (seconds) to cache a successful response.

file.description: Path to query log file (empty = disabled).

dirs.description: Directories containing blocklist files (one domain per line).

tcp_only.description: If true, use TCP-only for all upstream connections (disables UDP).

ecs_override.description: If true, send ECS options with client-subnet information.

ecs_range_ipv4.description: IPv4 subnet mask bits to preserve in ECS (e.g., 24 = /24).

ecs_range_ipv6.description: IPv6 subnet mask bits to preserve in ECS (e.g., 56 = /56).
